note: Derived from the Autumn Crossing 1K HDRI (Poly Haven, CC0). Ambient/environment reference only — the key light direction is pinned by src/render-style.js, not by this file. The source HDRI is a forest path with an obstructed sky view, so the upper-hemisphere average already includes canopy.

conventions.basis: x east, y up, z south (game map space)
conventions.equirect: row 0 = zenith; theta = polar angle from +Y; phi = azimuth
conventions.shBasis: real SH, bands 0..2, order [0, y, z, x, xy, yz, 3y^2-1, xz, x^2-z^2]
conventions.units: linear radiance from the HDRI, before tone mapping
